items.title: Introducing enhanced snapshots for Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink
items.summary: Enhanced snapshots for Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink are now generally available. An enhanced snapshot is an AWS resource with its own ARN, decoupled from the application that created it, so you can start another application from it, export it to Amazon S3, and import savepoints for blue/green deployments, disaster recovery, and migrations.
items.creator: Francisco Morillo
